description: Exact raw CSV files from Fernández-López et al.'s open Mendeley Data v5 release. The release is retained as a seminology feature-and-fertility benchmark only; it is not a sentinel, RF or causal-analysis input.
retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS retrieval of public Mendeley Data v5 file-download endpoints. Dataset landing DOI: 10.17632/jd38jhxpg6.5.

files.note: 221 direct insemination-event records: boar and sow identifiers, dates, litter outcomes, raw Success binary and ejaculate identifier. Mendeley metadata calls Success pregnancy while the associated article discusses farrowing rate; this discrepancy remains unresolved.
98,020 individual-sperm CASA rows from 17 boars and 36 ejaculates. Kinematic NA rows are source-reported nonmotile cells; raw bytes are never edited.
